keyPhrases.text: cast and crew bristling with Tony Awards
sad casualty of its own wandering mind
feels hopelessly distracted from beginning to end
blurs into one pretty, jittery haze
Your instinct is to call out... Focus!

reasoning: Despite acknowledging the talented cast and crew, the review is overwhelmingly critical of the production's execution. The critic uses harsh metaphors (comparing it to ADD, coitus interruptus) and describes it as hopelessly distracted and unfocused. The tone is more critical than complimentary, placing it in the 2/5 star range.
